label: Delivery redelivery fee
template: Parcelo: Your package is held at the distribution center. A fee of {{amount}} is required before delivery. Pay now: {{tokenUrl}}
realWorldNote: USPS/UPS redelivery-fee texts peaked in 2024; small dollar amounts bypass skepticism.

label: Unpaid toll notice
template: ExpressLane: You have an unpaid toll of {{amount}} from {{location}}. Late fees apply after 48h. Settle: {{tokenUrl}}
realWorldNote: Toll-authority smishing surged after E-ZPass expansion; the dollar amount is designed to feel too small to verify.

label: Bank fraud hold
template: {{bank}} Alert: We detected a {{amount}} charge from {{city}}. Reply YES to approve or NO to dispute: {{tokenUrl}}
realWorldNote: Fake bank alerts drive the victim to call back a scammer-controlled number — the reply bait is the pivot.

label: Boss asking for gift cards
template: Hey, it's {{bossName}}. Stuck in a meeting but I need you to grab {{count}} {{brand}} gift cards for a client thank-you. I'll reimburse. Can you do it now? {{tokenUrl}}
realWorldNote: Business email/text compromise variant; gift cards are untraceable and non-reversible.

label: Tax balance due
template: Final Notice — Revenue Services: You owe {{amount}} in back taxes. Enforcement action begins {{deadline}}. Resolve: {{tokenUrl}}
realWorldNote: The IRS never texts; the real agency only sends paper mail first. Scammers lean on fear of enforcement.

label: Sweepstakes winner
template: Congrats {{firstName}}! You won a {{prize}} in the {{sponsor}} drawing. Claim within {{deadline}}: {{tokenUrl}}
realWorldNote: Prize scams exploit the thrill of winning; a 'shipping fee' payment page follows the click.

label: Account lockout warning
template: {{provider}} Security: Unusual sign-in from {{city}}. Your account will lock in {{minutes}} minutes. Verify: {{tokenUrl}}
realWorldNote: Credential-phishing shell; the far-away city primes the victim to act without checking the URL.
